text.body: oṃ saha nāvavatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || brahmāvarte mahābhāṇḍīravaṭamūle mahāsatrāya sametā maharṣayaḥ śaunakādayaste ha samitpāṇayastattvajijñāsavo mārkaṇḍeyaṃ ciraṃjīvinamupasametya papracchuḥ kena tvaṃ ciraṃ jīvasi kena vānandamanubhavasīti ||1|| paramarahasyaśivatattvajñāneneti sa hovāca ||2|| kiṃ tatparamarahasyaśivatattvajñānam | tatra ko devaḥ | ke mantrāḥ | ko japaḥ | kā mudrā | kā niṣṭhā | kiṃ tajjñānasādhanam | kaḥ parikaraḥ | ko baliḥ | kaḥ kālaḥ | kiṃ tatsthānamiti ||3|| sa hovāca | yena dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ śivo'parokṣīkṛto bhavati tatparamarahasyaśivatattvajñānam ||4|| yaḥ sarvoparame kāle sarvānātmanyupasaṃhṛtya svātmānandasukhe modate prakāśate vā sa devaḥ ||5|| atraite mantrarahasyaślokā bhavanti | medhā dakṣiṇāmūrtimantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ | gāyatrī chandaḥ | devatā dakṣiṇāsyaḥ | mantreṇāṅganyāsaḥ ||6|| oṃ ādau nama uccārya tato bhagavate padam | dakṣiṇeti padaṃ paścānmūrtaye padamuddharet | asmacchabdaṃ caturthyantaṃ medhāṃ prajñāṃ padaṃ vadet | samuccārya tato vāyubījaṃ cchaṃ ca tataḥ paṭhet | agnijāyāṃ tatastveṣa caturviṃśākṣaro manuḥ || 7 || dhyānam | sphaṭikarajatavarṇaṃ mauktikīmakṣamālāmamṛtakalaśavidyāṃ jñānamudrāṃ karāgre | dadhatamuragakakṣyaṃ candracūḍaṃ trinetraṃ vidhṛtavividhabhūṣaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimīḍe || 8 || mantreṇa nyāsaḥ | ādau vedādimuccārya svarādyaṃ savisargakam | pañcārṇaṃ tata uddhṛtya antaraṃ savisargakam | ante samuddharettāraṃ manureṣa navākṣaraḥ || 9 || mudrāṃ bhadrārthadātrīṃ sa paraśuhariṇaṃ bāhubhirbāhumekaṃ jānvāsaktaṃ dadhāno bhujagabilasamābaddhakakṣyo vaṭādhaḥ | āsīnaścandrakhaṇḍapratighaṭi jaṭākṣīragaurastrinetro dadyādādyaḥ śukādyairmunibhirabhivṛto bhāvaśuddhiṃ bhavo naḥ || 10 || mantreṇa nyāsaḥ brahmarṣinyāsaḥtāraṃ brūṃnama uccārya māyāṃ vāgbhavameva ca | dakṣiṇāpadamuccārya tataḥ syānmūrtaye padam || 11 || jñānaṃ dehi padaṃ paścādvahnijāyāṃ tato nyaset | manuraṣṭādaśārṇo'yaṃ sarvamantreṣu gopitaḥ || 12 || bhasmavyāpāṇḍuraṅgaḥ śaśiśakaladharo jñānamṛdrākṣamālāvīṇāpustairvirājatkarakamaladharo yogapaṭṭābhirāmaḥ | vyākhyāpīṭhe niṣaṇṇo munivaranikaraiḥ sevyamānaḥ prasannaḥ savyālaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ satatamavatu no dakṣiṇāmūrtirīśaḥ || 13 || mantreṇa nyāsaḥ | [brahmarṣinyāsaḥ] tāraṃ paraṃ ramābījaṃ vadetsāṃbaśivāya ca | tubhyaṃ cānalajāyāṃ manurdvādaśavarṇakaḥ || 14 || vīṇāṃ karaiḥ pustakamakṣamālāṃ bibhrāṇamabhrābhagalaṃ varāḍhyam | phaṇīndrakakṣyaṃ munibhiḥ śukādyaiḥ sevyaṃ vaṭādhaḥ kṛtanīḍamīḍe || 15 || viṣṇū ṛṣiranuṣṭup chandaḥ | devatā dakṣiṇāsyaḥ | mantreṇa nyāsaḥ | tāraṃ namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vaṭapadaṃ tataḥ | mūleti padamuccārya vāsine padamuddharet || 16 || vāgīśāya tataḥ paśrcānmahājñānapadaṃ tataḥ | dāyine padamuccārya māyine nama uddharet || 17 || ānuṣṭubho mantrarājaḥ sarvamantrottamotamaḥ || 18 || dhyānam | mudrāpustakavahnināgavilasadbāhuṃ prasannānanaṃ muktāhāravibhūṣaṇaṃ śaśikalābhāsvatkirīṭojjvalam | ajñānāpahamādimādimagirāmarthaṃ bhavānīpatiṃ nyagrodhāntanivāsinaṃ paraguruṃ dhyāyāmyabhīṣṭāptaye || 19 || maunamudrā | so'hamiti yāvadāsthitiḥ sā niṣṭhā bhavati ||20|| tadabhedena mantrāmreḍanaṃ jñānasādhanam ||21|| citte tadekatānatā parikaraḥ ||22|| aṅgaceṣṭārpaṇaṃ baliḥ ||23|| trīṇi dhāmāni kālaḥ |||24|| dvādaśāntapadaṃ sthānamiti ||25|| te ha punaḥ śraddadhānāstaṃ pratyūcuḥ | kathaṃ vā'syodayaḥ | kiṃ svarūpam | ko vā'syopāsaka iti ||26|| sa hovāca | vairāgyatailasaṃpūrṇe bhaktivartisamanvite | prabodhapūrṇapātre tu jñaptidīpaṃ vilokayet || 27 || mohāndhakāre niḥsāre udeti svayameva hi | vairāgyamaraṇiṃ kṛtvā jñānaṃ kṛtvottarāraṇim || 28 || gāḍhatāmisrasaṃśāntyai gūḍhamarthaṃ nivedayet | mohabhānujasaṃkrāntaṃ vivekākhyaṃ mṛkaṇḍujam || 29 || tattvāvicārapāśena baddhaṃ dvaitabhayāturam | ujjīvayannijānande svasvarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 30 || śemuṣī dakṣiṇā proktā sā yasyābhīkṣaṇe mukham | dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ proktaḥ śivo'sau brahmavādibhiḥ || 31 || sargādikāle bhagavānviriñcirupāsyainaṃ sargasāmarthyamāpya | tutoṣa citte vāñchitārthāṃśca labdhvā dhanyaḥ sopāsyopāsako bhavati dhātā || 32 || ya imāṃ paramarahasyaśivatattvavidyāmadhīte sa sarvapāpebhyo mukto bhavati | ya evaṃ veda sa kaivalyamanubhavatītyupaniṣat ||33|| iti dakṣiṇāmurtyupaniṣatsamāptaḥ || oṃ saha nāvavatu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejasvināvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahai || oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
